The '''52nd Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 1999, were presented on March 11, 2000 at the [[Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Welkos|first1=Robert|title=DGA Award Nudges Mendes Closer to Oscar|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2000-mar-13-ca-8272-story.html|access-date=February 2, 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=March 13, 2000}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Announces Winners of 1999 Outstanding Directorial Achievement Awards and Recipients of 2000 Lifetime Achievement Awards|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2000/0311-DGA-Announces-Winners-of-1999-Outstanding-Directorial-Achievement-Awards-and-Recipients.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=February 2, 2018|date=March 11, 2000}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Errico|first1=Marcus|title=DGA Awards a "Beauty" Contest|url=http://www.eonline.com/news/39543/dga-awards-a-beauty-contest|website=E!
